feedback.end: Foxes are common mammals here in the UK. They usually live in dens in forests and farmland, but you can also find many in cities.
Foxes are strong and agile hunters. They mainly hunt rabbits and mice, but they also eat berries and nuts. This means that they are omnivores.
Foxes have an incredible sense of sight and smell. Foxes mostly hunt at night, so they need to be able to see well in the dark.

instruction.text: Match each species of fox to the correct name.

hint.text:
Red foxes get their name from their red fur. These are the foxes that live in the UK.

Grey foxes have grey fur, which provides camouflage against the tree trunks in the forests of North America.

Arctic foxes live in very cold climates, where there is often lots of snow. They have white fur so they can camouflage easily.
